description: This file defines the HeaderFooterDrawing class, which extends the Drawing class, and provides a method to generate a hash code based on its properties for use in the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: HeaderFooterDrawing
classes.description: Represents a drawable header or footer element in a worksheet, capable of generating a hash code based on its properties.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a unique hash code for the HeaderFooterDrawing instance based on its properties.
